strings.name: Zhang Yiming
strings.summary: After Nankai University, Zhang worked on travel search and property information before co-founding ByteDance with Liang Rubo and others in 2012. Teams developed Toutiao, Douyin and TikTok using recommendation technology. He handed over the CEO and chair roles in 2021 saying he would focus on longer-term research. Global expansion brought content-governance, data-security and regulatory pressures.
